title: Spring Day in my Rural Cottage Life
en: you picking wildflowers is a passion of mine they are so abundant here that making a little bouquet is a seasonal treat that I look forward to all year you see I live in a very rural part of Washington state and the local wildflowers are mostly undisturbed by humans I'm also happy to say they're visited often by the bees I always try to be conscious when I forage seeking the most abundant places

not picking more than a couple flowers in one spot I ask for permission to take bounty reassuring nature that I will cherish her work and that she will not have to share more than the smallest portion you I think using this method is an excellent philosophy for life consume carefully and consciously and appreciate the wonder and beauty of what you have

as humans we often take more than we need not being able to imagine a life where shopping and traveling isn't a priority but it is possible and I find that much satisfaction can come from it that is my secret I will see you guys next time consider subscribing if you enjoyed this video have a lovely day
zh: 你采摘野花是我的爱好，它们在这里如此丰富，以至于制作一点花束是一种季节性的享受，我全年都期待着你看，我住在华盛顿州的一个非常乡村的地方，当地的野花大多没有受到人类的干扰，我也很高兴地说，它们经常被蜜蜂拜访，当我寻找最丰富的地方时，我总是尽量保持警惕
在一个地方采摘的花不超过几朵 我请求允许接受赏金 让大自然放心，我会珍惜她的工作，她不会分享超过你的最小部分 我认为使用这种方法是一种很好的生活哲学 仔细而有意识地消费，欣赏你所拥有的奇迹和美丽
作为人类，我们经常需要的东西比我们需要的要多，无法想象购物和旅行不是优先事项的生活，但这是可能的，我发现可以从中获得很大的满足感，这是我的秘密，我下次再见，如果您喜欢这个视频，请考虑订阅，祝您度过愉快的一天
